display.purpose: Decisive headlines, offer names, and proof values.

body.purpose: Readable operating detail and long-form explanation.

note.purpose: Sparse working annotations and section tags.

shadows.name: card-offset
shadows.purpose: Physical offer, quote, proof, and form surfaces.

motion.name: direct-feedback
motion.purpose: Press and hover movement toward an offset shadow.

motion.name: section-reveal
motion.purpose: One-time entrance reveal, disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Tactile Primary Button
components.description: Violet commitment action with ink outline and offset shadow.
components.css: .button-primary { min-height:46px; border:2px solid var(--ink); border-radius:12px; background:var(--violet); color:var(--paper); box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--ink); font:700 16px/1.1 'Hanken Grotesk',sans-serif; }

components.name: Working Note
components.description: A sparse handwritten annotation that adds human context after a heading.
components.css: .section-note { display:inline-block; border:2px solid var(--ink); border-radius:6px; padding:4px 10px; background:var(--butter); color:var(--ink); font:700 15px/1.2 Kalam,cursive; transform:rotate(-1.5deg); }

components.name: Playbook Board
components.description: A tactile three-step operating artifact that turns method into memorable evidence.
components.css: .playbook-board { border:3px solid var(--ink); border-radius:20px; padding:42px; background:var(--surface); box-shadow:10px 10px 0 var(--coral); transform:rotate(1.5deg); }

components.name: Receipt Row
components.description: A bordered working sheet that pairs a specific claim with an oversized proof value.
components.css: .ledger-row { min-height:82px; border:2px solid var(--ink); border-radius:14px; padding:16px 20px; background:var(--lilac); box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--coral); color:var(--ink); }

components.name: Tactile Field
components.description: Explicitly labeled, high-contrast field with a physical offset cue.
components.css: input { min-height:48px; border:2px solid var(--ink); border-radius:12px; padding:13px 16px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:3px 3px 0 color-mix(in oklch,var(--ink),transparent 76%); }

narrative.creativeNorthStar: A founder opens a beautifully marked-up working brief at a sunlit table before a decisive 20-minute conversation.
